info.name: Macrometa API Reference Activity Metrics Usage Metrics API

params.name: from
params.description: The UTC start date and time when usage information is retrieved (e.g. 2022-01-01T00:00:00Z).

params.name: to
params.description: The UTC end date and time when usage information is retrieved (e.g. 2022-01-01T00:00:00Z).

params.name: sortBy
params.description: Sort by arrtibute.

params.name: sortOrder
params.description: Sort order.

params.name: aggregate
params.description: If the *aggregate* flag is true, then the result are consolidated and returned as an aggregated summary for the specified from and to period.  If the aggregate flag is false or not provided, then only separate records for the same time period is returned.

params.name: limit
params.description: The *limit* parameter determines the number of usage records to be returned.'

params.name: offset
params.description: The *offset* from which data is to be returned from total queried records.
